entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: My fortune readings said[n]that you're OK, but...

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: I'm still worried about you,[n]so please let me know.

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: You appear to have avoided[n]your destiny of death...

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: However, I can't see[n]anything past that.

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: If you're unsure about anything,[n]I'll be waiting at the usual spot.
